thesis: The dated 15.2% quarterly profit decline outweighs older cash-flow support for immediate buying. Restraint wins; the evidence does not establish permanent impairment or an outright short thesis.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue still grew 3.6% and snapshot FCF exceeds profit at 18.43x earnings, making temporary cost pressure a credible recovery case.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive year-on-year EPS growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of falling same-store sales and falling operating margin.
evidence_gaps: Store-level profitability, lease liabilities and current cash-conversion bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: The retailer remains cash-generative with growing revenue
Revenue growth and positive cash flow rebut a collapse narrative, but do not rebut the actual 15.2% quarterly profit decline
